adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the conditional spreads were flipped. Previously: when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` was false, `{ slug }` was written directly; when true, only `metadata.requestedSlug` was written. Now: when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is true, `{ slug }` is written (and `requestedSlug` still written), and when false, neither `slug` nor `requestedSlug` is written at all. This is directly verifiable from the diff and would both (a) change the intended “requested slug until activation” behavior under billing-enabled mode and (b) create orgs without a slug in billing-disabled mode, likely breaking URL/lookup flows.
